Grant these six fixed personal gear rows once without spending credits or rolling dice. Original receipts survive inventory edits and removal; unspecified weights remain unknown.

RMK, called Stitcher in the class list and Knitter in the equipment list: six reusable robots clean and suture external cuts with 90% suturing ability. They do not treat internal injuries, broken bones or severe wounds. This device capability does not change the character's Paramedic skill. Purchase price: 24000 credits. Ultimate Edition p.263 / PDF266.

PDD plays and records audio on one- and three-inch discs. Blank discs cost 10–20 credits for two or three hours; prerecorded discs cost 20–80 credits. PDD purchase price: 1200–2400 credits. Media selection remains pending. Ultimate Edition p.263 / PDF266.
The grappling hook does not grant its separate weapon proficiency. Hook attacks and its proficiency-dependent Climbing bonus remain pending.

movement_source.section: All environmental body armor have the following properties

items.name: Plastic-Man Full Environmental Body Armor (Operator buddy enhanced)
protection_notes: Environmental protection: filtered circulating air, cooling and temperature regulation. Five-hour independent oxygen supply for contaminated or low-oxygen environments.
Shielding resists heat up to 200 degrees Celsius. Normal fires cause no damage; nuclear, plasma and magic fires cause full damage. Incoming damage resolution remains pending.
Minimal radiation shielding, light-sensitive polarized visor, removable faceplate and directional helmet radio with 5–10 mile range. Ultimate Edition p.267 / PDF270.

Original source armor capacities increased by10% per location by an Operator buddy. Exact decimal capacities are retained; the source supplies no whole-point rounding rule. Ordinary purchased armor is unchanged.

Weapons, Body Armor, Vagabond Starting Money and Standard Equipment; Basic Gear; Standard E-Clip

guidance: Choose one reviewed armor, gun, knife, and transport option once; the matching spare E-Clip is granted automatically without a credit charge.
These are representative available options, not the complete range described for Vagabond starting equipment. Broader armor, weapon, and transport choices remain pending source review.
Plastic Man armor represents the medium M.D.C. armor choice. The source describes starting armor as beaten and battered; no change to its M.D.C. is inferred.
The old junker car, old junker motorcycle, and basic horse have no reviewed speed, durability, price, or weight here.
The selected car, motorcycle, or horse is initially stored rather than carried; travel and animal statistics remain pending source review.

source.section: Vagabond — Money

guidance: Starting funds are generated once. Four D6 are rolled without attribute house options.
Starting credits add to the current balance; later purchases or manual balance edits do not change the original rolls.
Roll starting credits and Black Market saleable goods value separately.
Saleable goods are recorded as a value; they are not added to credits or converted to equipment.
The rest of the Vagabond starting equipment is not yet implemented.
Grant the fixed personal gear once. It costs no credits and has no reviewed weight or combat effects.
The receipt records the original grant; later inventory edits or removal do not grant the items again.
Knife, armor, gun, spare clip and transport choices remain pending.
